name: rasonyang/ai-native-callcenter
title: rasonyang/ai-native-callcenter
headline: Self-hosted AI call center with realtime voice bots
lede: You can run an API-first call center where voice bots answer calls and human agents take over without dropping them.

effects.effect: Voice agents get a ready path to live human handoff.
Realtime voice models gain a telephony integration pattern.

possibilities.title: Regional call centers can self-host voice bots that understand local dialects

with.title: Ming models cover speech generation and understanding
SGLang-Omni serves audio and multimodal models

possibilities.connection: Ming-3.0's dialect-aware recognition and tool-calling audio understanding, served on SGLang-Omni, can plug into the self-hosted call center binary that already handles bot to human handoff.

possibilities.title: City and health hotlines can serve minority-language callers on self-hosted voice bots

with.title: VoiceStudio offers local voice suite in 646 languages

possibilities.connection: A local voice suite in 646 languages, a self-hosted call center with bot-to-human handoff, and a very fast cheap diffusion LLM together make low-latency multilingual phone service possible without sending audio to a hosted API.

appearances.title: rasonyang/ai-native-callcenter
appearances.headline: Self-hosted AI call center with realtime voice bots
appearances.newly_possible: You can run an API-first call center where voice bots answer calls and human agents take over without dropping them.
appearances.why: It packages telephony, realtime voice models and handoff into one Go binary with an OpenAPI spec.
appearances.limits: No metrics or deployment evidence in the input.
